name: B1060 - Web - Source Code & Developer Tools Control
description: Intent: Block-tier hard enforcement on Web clipboard paste and upload into the Unauthorized Source Code and Developer Tools surface at sensitivity floor [3,4] — shuts down code, secrets, and credential exfil into public GitHub, personal accounts, or non-sanctioned code hosts. Exclusions: excludes domains in Websites_Authorized_Source_Code_&_Developer_Tools_Domains_[is]; ships disabled — enable after enterprise git instances are in the Authorized list and W1061 is clean. Requirements: WIP — pending analyst testing.
